# lib/seed-hash

## Functions

### seedHash()

```ts
function seedHash(seed): number;
```

A stable 32-bit FNV-1a hash: the same seed always lands on the same value, and
short, similar seeds spread apart. Used to pick a deterministic tone, color, or
pattern from an identity (a name, an Agent id) without state.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type     |
| --------- | -------- |
| `seed`    | `string` |

#### Returns

`number`
